g.text: Same peak, but not equally tight: 100% down to 53%
One dot: one genus starting on one night

48 genera recorded; shown are those with 40 or more nights. A night is one genus on one reef. Waves are smoothed by about a day. Genera still differ on the same reef (labels shuffled within reefs, p < 0.001).
Platygyra also has a small new-moon peak (19% of its nights). Approximate start times are included. Field records show when people looked, not every night. Source: Baird et al. (2021).
Each wave is one genus across the lunar month: the higher the wave, the more of its spawning nights fall on that day.
Eleven genera peak after full moon and start in the evening. Pocillopora spawns by day, and in the Red Sea at new moon.
Most coral genera share one timetable. Pocillopora does not
